quest.title: Our Purpose Is in Another Canal
quest.description: Repairing the Fortress of Meropide's piping is no mean feat...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Lumitoile x3

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: That kid, he didn't get caught by Hilichurls and tossed into their stew, did he...

response.speaker: Aigouy
response.text: Look, see that Hilichurl camp by the water over there?

response.speaker: Aigouy
response.text: It's as if it just appeared out of nowhere. They're working day in and day out and not resting when they should. *sigh* Just like Balent, that silly kid.

response.speaker: Aigouy
response.text: The way I see it, luck's on his side, so he's probably not cooking in a pot right now. Maybe he's having an animated little chat with the Hilichurls as we speak. Who knows?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? So what you're saying is that someone you know was taken by the Hilichurls over there? How are you not worried at all? If you're serious, then we need to hurry up and go save him!

response.speaker: Aigouy
response.text: Save him? Why? I already told him that there's no need to bust his chops like that for such a dangerous job. Just report it to Estienne during the scheduled check-in and have him find someone to deal with it.

response.speaker: Aigouy
response.text: I was kind enough to teach him, but just how did that kid repay me? He accused me of not taking work seriously and neglecting my duties.

response.speaker: Aigouy
response.text: Seeing as he doesn't take the wisdom and experience of his elders seriously, all I have to say is that this was all his own choice. Young people ought to get a few knocks and bruises. How can they grow up without learning a few tough lessons?

choices.text: It's hard to judge without hearing both sides of the story.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right, we've got some saving to do.

response.speaker: Aigouy
response.text: It's dangerous out there! What if you youngsters get hurt?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Relax! {NICKNAME} is really strong! Just wait right here, Gramps! We'll be back in a jiffy!

choices.text: He could be in danger, and you can't mature and grow if you're dead.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is that really the point!?

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: If you were hurt in the process of saving that rascal Balent, then he ought to make it up to you by taking a few days of leave and looking after you!

talks.objective: Go look for Balent in the Hilichurl camp on the water

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: What's up? Having trouble? Is there something about the maintenance work that you don't understand? Let me explain it again then!

response.speaker: Balent
response.text: If you notice there's a <color=#00E1FFFF>gas leak</color> in the pipeline, then it was likely caused by an aquatic creature... or non-creature object colliding with it.

response.speaker: Balent
response.text: The emergency measure here is to <color=#00E1FFFF>control the flow by adjusting the regulator valve, temporarily stopping the gas leak</color>. That's all you need to do.

response.speaker: Balent
response.text: There's a technique for adjusting the regulator valve. <color=#00E1FFFF>When rotating the handwheel, you must keep an eye on the gas flow volume. If it is decreasing, then you are on the right track</color>.

response.speaker: Balent
response.text: It shouldn't be that difficult. I'm counting on you.

response.speaker: Balent
response.text: Much obliged, then.

dialogues.text: You two are... too kind... Thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you alright?
I... I'm... fine... I think...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your appearance begs to differ.
C—Could you guys take me to the pier over there... I... I...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, save your breath for now. We'll take you back!

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: You two are... too kind... Thank you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: I... I'm... fine... I think...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your appearance begs to differ.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You'd better hurry back to the pier with us!
Monsieur Aigouy, I... I'm back...

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: You two... Looks like you saved Balent. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: Silly boy! I told you before that there's no need to work so hard at such a dangerous job. Just report it to Estienne during the scheduled check-in and have him find someone to deal with it.

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: I taught you out of the goodness of my heart, and what did you give me in return? You accused me of not taking work seriously and of neglecting my duties.

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: And now look, just what did I say? It was too dangerous for you to deal with. You didn't believe me then, but hopefully, you've learned your lesson now.

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: What, still don't want to admit you were wrong? I'd really like to hear just what other enlightened opinions you still have to offer.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: I want to drink some water...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Balent finds a water bottle and gulps down several mouthfuls, then breaks off a piece of dry bread and starts chewing.\nThe whole time, he is completely focused on eating and drinking, seemingly deaf to the old man's words, regardless of what he says.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: Whew... At least... At least I'm still alive. Thank you for your help, were it not for you two, I'm afraid I probably...

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: ...Probably would have left your parents with nothing but survivor benefits.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: Hmph! That would still be better than getting fired for causing a huge safety incident and getting fired because I was slacking on the job!

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: You little... *sigh* Nothing I say ever gets through to you!

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: Guys, this may sound a little shameless, but I've got to say it... This is for everybody's safety.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: I assume the two of you know how to dive, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, but...

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: When I was captured by the Hilichurls, I lost my divesuit. Our routine inspections revealed that the spares were defective, and though we've applied for new ones, they haven't been delivered yet...

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: But, the maintenance of pipelines cannot be delayed. If the two of you know how to dive, then could you please go inspect the Fortress pipelines for me?

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: Of course, you will be well compensated for your work, so don't worry about that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seeing as this involves everybody's safety, it's not like we can't do it. Inspecting pipelines sounds like a job that should be left to professionals, though. Are you sure about leaving it to us?

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: It's nothing more than a routine checkup. I'm expecting there will be some minor problems, as there were four areas at risk for leaks the last time I did an inspection. They shouldn't be that difficult to fix, though. I'll explain it to you!

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: If you notice there's a <color=#00E1FFFF>gas leak</color> in the pipeline, then it was likely caused by an aquatic creature... or non-creature object colliding with it.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: The emergency measure here is to <color=#00E1FFFF>control the flow by adjusting the regulator valve, temporarily stopping the gas leak</color>. That's all you need to do.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: There's a technique for adjusting the regulator valve. <color=#00E1FFFF>When rotating the handwheel, you must keep an eye on the gas flow volume. If it is decreasing, then you are on the right track</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Paimon thinks she gets it now!

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: Should you have any questions about your job, I'll be happy to clarify them for you at any time before you complete the routine inspection.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay! Let's give it a shot!

talks.objective: Return to the pier and report to Aigouy

talks.objective: Fix the underwater pipelines near the Fortress of Meropide

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back! There were indeed a few small problems, but don't worry! We handled them all by following the instructions you gave us.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: Your help is truly appreciated. If you hadn't fixed those potential safety risks in a timely manner, it would've been far too late to fix them had we let them fester into a larger disaster.

dialogues.speaker: Balent
dialogues.text: ...And this is why I don't see eye to eye with Monsieur Aigouy, though I know that he's taking care of me in his own way.

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: *sigh* Same goes for you two, don't push yourselves too hard and throw yourselves at problems you can't handle.

dialogues.speaker: Aigouy
dialogues.text: Why waste your own time on all that annoying maintenance work, when there are others who can help...

response.speaker: Aigouy
response.text: The Fortress of Meropide has lots of pipelines. Someone needs to maintain them, don't they? That's our job.

response.speaker: Aigouy
response.text: It's mostly minor repairs, patching this and that up. I mean, what do they expect someone like me to do if something major happens, anyway?

response.speaker: Aigouy
response.text: I just do what I'm able to, like taking letters into the city for people when I have a day off...

response.speaker: Aigouy
response.text: Oh, I have no shortage of time. Not like I'm even remotely busy.
